title: Rental Caps for Geylang Serai Ramadan Bazaar 2024 and Similar Caps for Hawker Centres and Government-leased Commercial Properties
what_it_is: Rental Caps for Geylang Serai Ramadan Bazaar 2024 and Similar Caps for Hawker Centres and Government-leased Commercial Properties

sections.label: Bazaar 2024 rental cap
sections.summary: WGS decided to introduce a rental cap for Bazaar 2024, with PA and WGS to review the framework before future bazaars.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Given the above, WGS decided on introducing a rental cap for Bazaar 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The People's Association (PA) and WGS will continue to review the operation of the rental framework in the light of prevailing conditions before deciding on subsequent bazaars and trade fairs, which it organises.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On part (b) of the Parliamentary Question, other Government agencies may have different policies and considerations in relation to the pricing of rentals for hawker centres and commercial properties, which are quite different matters from considering the pricing of a bazaar like the Ramadan Bazaar.

sections.label: Average rental and cap basis
sections.summary: The 2024 cap is designed to keep average rental at roughly the 2023 level of about $500 per day, giving operators a bidding basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: If you look at the mechanism behind calculating the bazaar, I think Mr Chua said he understood the slightly shorter duration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, what we did was we looked at the average rental 2023 and looked at the number of stalls that are available and the duration and, by and large, when we work out the average rental in 2023, against the number of stalls that were available this year, the average rental would be about $500 per day, roughly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The cap that is going to be introduced in 2024 is designed to keep it at around, roughly, the same level or a little bit below.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: But the point is that there is a certain basis on which stall operators can now make a bid for the stalls, knowing that there will be this cap.

sections.label: Factors for subsequent years
sections.summary: Prevailing conditions, size and duration vary yearly and will be considered in subsequent years to achieve an optimal experience.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: But the other factors, such as, what are the prevailing conditions, how large it will be, for how long it will be held, and those sometimes vary from year to year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, we will take all that into account in subsequent years and bear in mind what Mr Chua has said, but look at, overall, achieving the optimal experience for both stall holders as well as for patrons.
